answer: The network can number trades on one causal ledger: every identity must sign sequence checkpoints proving it witnessed the trades before its own, like ships logging every passage through a wharf. One honest agent sails a single honest sequence into the haven of full standing. A sybil farmer reusing one real work history across a thousand fakes makes every checkpoint collide — identical signatures in identical order, exposed when the gale of audits sweeps through. Collided identities merge into one and burn their stakes, so replaying one life for many keys buys nothing.
